english: Nfufufu...
Sounds like you've taken an interest in me too.\nCan't blame you, honestly.
...Usada-san?
Don't call me Usada!\nIt's La Vie en Rose!
Never get it wrong.\nCall this La Vie en Rose by that name\nand you're done for.
I am an idol, you know.\nSay anything rude and I'll punish you.
But Dejiko-san told me to call you that...\nShe said you'd be happy if I did.
That's obviously a lie!\nKiii-!! Dejiko again!?
Don't fall for Dejiko's smooth talk.\nNothing good ever comes of it.
With that suspicious grin,\nshe keeps attacking me with her 'eye beams'.\nEvery time.
Well, it's obvious, isn't it? Jealousy.\nI understand why Dejiko\nwould be jealous of me.
Dejiko's aiming to be a great actress, apparently,\nbut that's a future that'll never come.
Feeling inferior to me, the idol,\ngetting jealous, acting out like that -\nI completely understand.
I suppose being an idol means\nhaving the tolerance\nto accept that kind of jealousy.
It's that generous heart of mine\nthat makes me an idol.\nYou agree, don't you?
Y-yeah...
Dejiko only does doujin stuff anyway,\nso comparing her to me is just pitiful.
And I have bunny ears -\na much lovelier charm point\nthan Dejiko's cat ears.
Y-yeah...\nI think the bunny ears are nice.
You get it!\nAre you a fan of mine?
People with taste just get it,\ndon't they?
This is the power of an idol...\nNfufufu...
Um... I think both are nice.
Whaaat!?\nThat's your taste?
Bunny ears are bigger and more useful, you know.
So, just to be clear -\nyou are my fan, right?
Huh? Um...
...You are, right?
Y-yes.
Good! That's the spirit!\nI've got to brag to Dejiko\nabout having fans everywhere.
Come on, let's go.\nNo time to dawdle.
I can just picture\nDejiko's frustrated face~.
Um... you don't have to fight, you know...
It's not a fight.\nIt's a contest!\nOne I can't lose!
So you can't stop being my fan -\nnot if I'm going to beat Dejiko, okay?
Y-yes...
Nfufufu...\nI feel great.
She never stops talking...\nAll I could do was nod along.
Lately I feel like Dejiko's\ngetting a little full of herself.
I-is that so?
She keeps looking at me\nand giggling, you know.
She's definitely spreading rumors about me -\ntrue or not.
Honestly!\nHow sneaky can Dejiko be!?
Haven't you heard anything?\nYou can tell me everything, no holding back.
No, not really...
Really?\nThat can't be right, though...
I mean, it's Dejiko we're talking about!\nThe girl who fires 'eye beams' at me\nwithout a second thought!
You have no idea how many times\nthat's put me through hell.
If I weren't a super idol\nwho can do anything,\nI'd have been wiped out a hundred times over.
...Wait - have you heard something\nand you're keeping quiet on purpose?\nBeing considerate of me...?
I wouldn't let something like that get me down,\nbut I appreciate the thought.\nReally.
Thanks.\nBut I want to know\nwhat Dejiko's been saying.
Please, won't you tell me?\nI won't get mad, I promise.
Um... even if you say that...\nDejiko-san... I really don't think she's even mentioned you...
Kiii-!!
Wha-!?\nYou said you wouldn't get mad...!
What do you mean, not even mentioned?!\nI'm Dejiko's rival!
And she's forgotten that?!\nUnbelievable!
That's the ultimate insult!
Hoo... hoo... hoo...\n...Nfufufu.\nHey?
Eep!?\nWh-what is it?
What's with the 'eep'... Honestly.\nWon't you tell Dejiko\nto talk about me properly?
I'm not asking you to spread bad rumors!\nJust... being ignored isn't right, is it?\nPass that along, okay?
O-okay...\nI'll pass it along properly.
Don't make it sound forced.\nJust naturally work in\nthat I'm Dejiko's rival, okay?
So... you're lonely because she's ignoring you?
Wh-where'd you get that idea?!\nI don't care about Dejiko at all -\nI just want to settle which of us is more popular.
I know I'd win,\nbut Dejiko deserves a chance too, right?\nSo... that's what it is!
Hehe. Got it.
What was that laugh?\nI don't like it one bit.
Anyway, I'm counting on you!\nI'll be devising my strategy\nto beat Dejiko... nfufufu.
(She says all that, but they really do get along...\nWell, I guess I'll pass it on to Dejiko-san.)
Nn-fufu-fu~♪
They're strange, you know... those ears.
My ears?\nSomething wrong with them?
How can you fly with them?
That's obvious, isn't it?\nThey're bunny ears - of course they can fly.
And among bunny ears, mine are special.\nThey can do all sorts of things.
Isn't that what sets them apart\nfrom cat ears?
...Um, does that count as an explanation?
Well then. For example -\nbirds flap their wings to fly, right?
Do you find it strange when you see a bird flying freely through the sky?
Well... I don't really think about it.
That's exactly what I mean.
Huh? Um, well...
Still not convinced?\nThen isn't it strange that airplanes fly?\nYou wonder how a hunk of iron does it, right?
But you trust that they can fly, don't you?\nIt's just like that.
Well, airplanes... I guess so.
See? Exactly.
Wha-!?\nIs that really how you convince someone?
I mean, I've got bunny ears, right?\nSpin them over my head\nand flying is only natural.
They're called bunny-ear propellers.\nWhat else would they be for?\nNfufufu.
Um... I don't really get it.\nI can't quite... buy it...
You worry about the details too much.\nI can control my bunny ears freely -\nisn't that enough?
A special skill even Dejiko can't do...\nOnly this La Vie en Rose\ncan pull it off!
O-ho-ho-ho!\nOne step closer to being an idol.
What kind of idol is La Vie en Rose-san aiming to be...\nexactly?
Well, fine then...
That's right!\nOnce you just accept it,\nit's no big deal.
The world is full of far stranger things\nthan my bunny ears.
Well, being thought of as mysterious\nmight not be so bad.
An idol has secrets she can't reveal -\none or two, three or four...\nabout a hundred of them.
Oh - that was good.\nI'll have to keep that in mind\nfrom now on.
R-right. For now...\nI'll just try not to think about it.
This is bad, baaad!!
Huh? What happened?
I dropped some of my stuff.
The bottom of my bag tore a little, and it fell out through there.
I had no idea my bag was broken...\nWhat a mess.\nThis is trouble.
It must've been important.\nWhat did you lose...?
I... can't say.\nIt's a little private.
But I'll be in trouble without it.\nIt's fine for now, but I'll get scolded later.
And there are things\nI need to get done with it.
Then just tell me what it looks like.
Some paper - a few sheets.\nJust think of it as documents.
They were important documents, but...\nwhat should I do?
Even if I search, I don't know when the bag broke\nor when I dropped the papers.
Thinking about it, it's hopeless...\nThey'll never turn up... I'll give up.\nSorry, forget I said anything.
...Someone might have picked them up.
Huh?\nThere is a chance, I guess...
Let's ask around.\nIf... there's a chance, I mean.
But they're not the kind of documents\nworth that much trouble.
It's true I'd be in trouble,\nbut it's manageable, kind of...
They're not worth\nfrantically searching for...
If they're gone, they're gone -\nbut they might be out there.
...Why are you being\nso kind about this?
...Because we're friends.
...I can't believe someone would say that with a straight face,\nright here next to me...
Ah, sorry, sorry!\nDon't regret saying it -\nI was just surprised, that's all.
Thanks.\nI'm happy, really.
...Why, I wonder?
Don't ask me.\nHonestly... hehe.
You're a strange one.\nBut it's a big help.
Then shall we ask around?\nIf we're doing this, we've got to find them.
You're helping, right?\nI'm counting on you.
But only when it's convenient.\nThey're really not worth getting worked up over.
Understood.\n...I hope they turn up.
Yeah.
Thanks to you,\nthe important documents turned up.
To think someone picked them up.\nGood thing I didn't just\nlose them somewhere.
...For someone who got them back, you look a little angry?
Can you tell?\nSomeone doodled all over\nmy documents...
The person who picked them up\nwas the worst...\nWhat was Dejiko thinking?
What are these drawings...?
Looks like a manga 'name' - a rough draft.\nDejiko makes doujinshi,\nso it's probably for that.
I forgot the deadline\nand didn't have paper ready,\nso it worked out great, nyo.
You should feel honored to play a part\nin Dejiko's wonderful work, nyo.\nAfter all...
Kiii-!!\nWhat 'wonderful work'?!\nDon't draw your rough drafts on my documents!
Well, that name was a rejected draft anyway,\nso take it home if you want, nyo.\nOn Usada's paper, rejection was inevitable, nyo.
Can you believe her!?\nWhy do I of all people\nhave to take that insult?!
Just remembering it makes me furious!
Still, at least they came back...\nright?
Ah, you dropped it.\nThe document.
Ah! It's fine!\nI'll get it my-
Huh... what's this?\nMath homework?
Th-thanks for picking it up!\nUm, this is...
Aren't you panicking a little?
...Honestly.\nI'm 14 too, you know.\nI have studying and stuff.
I'm not hiding it exactly,\nbut as La Vie en Rose\nI'd rather not put that out there.
An idol whose private life shows through\nis kind of weird, right?
A student and an idol... balancing both sounds tough.\nUm, keep it up... please.
...Thanks.
Can I ask you something...?\nSeeing my private life like that - are you disillusioned?
Not at all.\nDisillusioned? Never...
It's just, as far as my image as an idol goes,\nI'd rather keep that stuff hidden.
Still, if you're not disillusioned,\nthen... I guess that's good?
I don't think it was hidden... honestly?
What!?\nHow did you figure it out!?
I thought I was hiding it perfectly...\nI'll have to be more careful\nfrom now on.
And you've done nothing but help me.\nYou're really dependable.
I'd like to thank you properly someday.\nDon't hold your breath, though?
We're in the middle of a battle, so after that's over...\nI'll think about it then.
I am grateful. Really.
It's fine...\nI can tell.
Good, then.
Do you eat watermelon rinds?
Huh? What's with that question?\n...No, I don't.
...I see.\nWhat a waste.
Huh. So there really aren't many people\nwho eat watermelon rinds.
I think the rind is the tastiest part,\nbut nobody agrees with me,\nso I'm losing confidence.
You eat the rind?
Of course!\nIt's got a nice crunch,\nand it's tasty!
Like, you eat cucumbers\nwith the skin on, right?
Same thing.
Is it... really?
Dejiko and Puchiko\nonly eat the inside, too.
I get the rinds every time,\nwhich suits me fine, but...\nmaybe I'm the weird one...?
I think it's weird...\nPeople don't eat watermelon rinds.
But I actually eat them!\nIt's not like you can't eat them -\npeople just don't!
Don't knock it till you try it.\nWhy don't you try some?
To each their own...\nI think it's fine if some people eat the rind.
Right?\nIt's normal for me,\nand I won't stop even if people judge.
You should try some too.\nYou'll get hooked, I bet.\nGotta try everything once.
That said...\nwatermelons aren't exactly\neasy to come by right now...
Too bad.\nI thought I'd found a kindred spirit...\nGuess not.
Well, well...
You look relieved, somehow?
No! Not at all!
Even Majin Gappa won't eat them...\nI want someone who gets it, soon.
Majin Gappa?
The kappa I keep around.\nHaven't you seen it?
It loves cucumbers but won't eat watermelon rinds -\nweird, right?
Maybe I'll force-feed\nMajin Gappa some next time...
(You don't have to be that obsessed with watermelon rinds...)
Weren't you just thinking 'she doesn't have to be\nthat obsessed with watermelon rinds'...?
Gah-!?
You're so easy to read...\nAfter all that, you still don't get it.\nOh well...
Let's talk a little more\nabout watermelon rinds?
(Why are you THIS fixated on this-!?)
Huh? Something's...
Hm? What's wrong?\nSomething on my face?
Staring that hard is bad manners,\nyou know.
Well, I understand\nbeing entranced by me.
If that's the case, it can't be helped.\nBeing too charming\nis the problem, right?
No. It's the dice on your head -\nit looks different from usual... I thought.\nJust my imagination... right?
You just casually said 'no'\nto that...
Well, whatever.\nStill, good eye.\nThis one's a spare.
I took the real one off for a bit -\nI needed it for something.
It was supposed to be\nan identical spare...\nbut you noticed. Good eye.
Just luck.\nI just... had a feeling.
I see.\nThat actually makes me a little happy.
That means you've been\nwatching me closely, right?
As long as you're not a stalker,\nthat's really encouraging.
...You're not a stalker, right?
Don't ask me that...\nI'm not...
Good, then.
Noticing things most people wouldn't...\nthat raises your stock a little,\ndoesn't it?
So you're not that dense after all.\nMm-hm. Wonderful.
Th-thank you...
I like that honest side of you,\ntoo.
Hehe. Your rating keeps climbing\nin my book.
Does that mean... maybe...?
Don't get the wrong idea.\nYou jump to conclusions too fast.
If a little praise gets you cocky,\nyou've still got a long way to go.\nMm-hm.
So...\nwhat happened to the real dice?
...I lent it to Puchiko.\nShe looked tired.
A big dice like this\nmakes a perfect chair\nfor a little one like her, right?
She's so small but trying so hard\nto keep up -\nI should treat her a little.
But I should get it back soon.\nIf you can tell it's a spare, after all.
They really do get along...\nEven La Vie en Rose-san\nlooks out for her kindly.
(Getting along...\nI wonder about me...)
Wake up!
...Hm? Huh?\nLa Vie en Rose-san?\nWhere are we?
Come on... wake up!\nWe've got to get to the classroom.
Huh? Classroom?\nWait... hold on!
Ta-daa!\nPretty nicely decorated, right?
Um, La Vie en Rose-san? What is all this...?\nAnd that outfit?
Well? Suits me, doesn't it?\nA change of outfit now and then is nice.
I like my usual outfit,\nbut I guess I look good in anything.
It's the school festival today,\nso I wanted you to have fun.
Oh, and - we're at school right now,\nso call me Usada. That's my real name.
Usada...-san? School festival...?\nOh! That's why we're in a classroom...
Obviously?\nHehe. You're acting strange, you know?
I brought you because I wanted customers,\nbut I'll treat you properly.
First, tea and cake!
Huh? I haven't ordered yet?
Oh? You don't want tea and cake? I went to the trouble of preparing it...\nThen what would you like?
N-no, it's not that I don't want it...\nI'll have that, then.
One moment.\nFuuu. Fuuu.
Wouldn't want you to burn yourself.\nHere you go.
Th-thank... you.
Don't be shy -\nyou'll make me embarrassed too.
Since we're here, enjoy yourself properly.\nIf there's anything else you want, just ask.
...But...\nI don't do this for just anyone, you know?
Not that I'm making excuses,\nbut I don't want you thinking I'm easy, either...
I'm only going this far\nbecause it's you, okay?
So... if you...\nwish...
Huh? I can't hear you...\nWhat is it... Usada-san?
Mmm...
Oh, you're up.\nWhat are you sleeping for?\nYou've got no sense of urgency.
Usada...-san?
Wh-?!\nIt's La Vie en Rose!\nHow many times do I have to tell you!?
Huh? The school?\nThe festival?
What... are you talking about?
School festival...\nSounds like you were having quite the peaceful dream.
What. Why are you staring at me like that...?\nDon't tell me... you were having\nsome weird dream!?
Just because it was a dream\ndoesn't mean everything's forgiven!
Enough - pull yourself together.
Yes...
It's like... I've gained a little brother.\nThis must be what having a kid brother\nwho needs looking after is like.
L-little brother!?\nI'm older than you!
You want me to see you as a big brother?\nA hundred years too early for that.
I don't need a big brother\nwho's nothing but trouble.
Then... as a man...?
I'm an idol, so\nI don't need scandalous talk\nlike that!
Too bad~.\nStart by growing up a little,\nfirst.
